experiment: Experiment 82.2.2 RCE-PSCE — Reliability-aware Counterfactual Evidence for Prompt-guided Spectral Learning
covariance: unbiased n-1; pooled weighted by n_c
selection: strict ACC improvement on test; retain earliest tie
preprocessing: historical pre-CV scaling/RFE; transductive graph; val=test preserved
eigen_tie_rule: gaps <= 1e-12 max absolute eigenvalue: coordinate-projector canonicalization; stable signed tie order; sign largest absolute coordinate positive
degenerate_rule: trace <= epsilon: zero term; overall norm <= epsilon: complement total covariance fallback
teacher: Per-epoch current original OutputLayer deepcopy, detached eval, legal training raw CAM only, no RNG
valid_rule: legal & teacher correct & true margin>0 & max(relu(D8)*rho)>1e-6
harm_valid_rule: same valid reliable patients as CF; equal mean over present ASD/TD classes
scale_rule: warmup correct legal patients abs(D8)>1e-6; float64 midpoint median; max(median,1e-3); immutable
auxiliary_gradient: extra deterministic PSCE(z.detach()); auxiliary CF and harm update only PSCE
semantic_off: original E82.2 w=w_sp; residual-off=noop uniform w

GO_all: G2 ACC>B0 and fold ACC wins>losses
q substitution mean abs probability>=0.001 and net correction<0
reliable target alignment at Best exceeds initial on same Best CAM; no zero residual collapse
scientific_rules.PARTIAL: only when G2 exceeds B0 and residual has diagnostic benefit, with some GO conditions lacking; cannot claim medical innovation
scientific_rules.NO_GO: otherwise; stop E82 spectral-semantic route, no E82.2.3 or search

initialization_validation: rebuild pinned original E82.2 PSCE in isolated RNG, exact named-parameter and saved SHA check; no independent initial file claimed
zero_residual_collapse_rule: mean test residual norm ratio to historical E82.2-G2 <=0.1, or mean relative norm<=1e-5
